release_notes: Pins the editor command header while the document body scrolls in Quotation, Proforma Invoice and Tax Invoice.
Keeps document title, autosave status, Duplicate, Save, Preview/export actions and Grammar access visible while editing long documents in a reduced-height window.
Implements the pinned editor header through one shared editor-header primitive rather than separate per-editor sticky-header logic.
Applies the same editor-shell behavior across Quotation, Proforma Invoice and Tax Invoice.
Uses available viewport height and content overflow rather than Windows maximized/restored state to determine scrolling behavior.
Preserves normal maximized-window layout while improving usability in restored, snapped and smaller-height windows.
Keeps only the document body inside the vertical scrolling region; editor-level command controls remain outside that scroll region.
Adds a subtle separation cue when document content has scrolled beneath the pinned command header.
Preserves quotation, proforma invoice and tax invoice calculations, numbering, revisions, templates and document-generation behavior.
Preserves database schema 10 with no migration required.
Preserves the existing %LOCALAPPDATA%\Quotation Manager application-data location.
Preserves Python 3.14.7 x64, SQLite 3.50.4, PySide6/Qt 6.11.2, PyInstaller 6.22.3 and Inno Setup 7.1.0 from the certified v1.3.0 runtime stack.
Preserves the hardened OTA transport, installer SHA-256 and size verification, redirect restrictions, rollback protection and post-update health validation.
Preserves the automatic Update Available popup introduced in v1.3.0 when a newer release is discovered in the background.
Preserves the bounded, scrollable release-notes viewport with Later and Download & Install kept visible at the bottom of the update dialog.
Preserves visible global download/preparation progress during OTA installation preparation.
Preserves visible Windows/Inno installer progress after the verified update download instead of using a fully hidden installer.
This release is the first controlled production OTA intended to validate the v1.3.0 updater UX end-to-end during a v1.3.0 -> v1.3.1 update.
Windows validation, hands-on v1.3.1 UAT, in-place v1.3.0 -> v1.3.1 data preservation and rollback to exact v1.3.0/R57 all passed before publication.
Product version: 1.3.1.
Database schema: 10 (unchanged).
Installer AppId, install location and data location remain unchanged.
v1.3.0/R57 is the mandatory direct rollback installer for the v1.3.0 -> v1.3.1 OTA upgrade.
